attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation – Board of Pharmacy

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved providers; in person or remote (live or pre-recorded). Sexual harassment, implicit bias and cultural competency courses may also come from any IDFPR-approved sponsor, government agencies, accredited colleges or licensed health care institutions
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal of a license.
rules.alternatives: One-time CE waiver may be requested with the renewal, before expiration: full-time armed forces service, incapacitating illness documented by a physician, or temporary undue hardship (third-party evidence required).
rules.audit_note: During renewal licensees answer YES/NO that CE is complete; proof only for random audits, restoration or discipline. Keep proof of CE.

topics.who: Renewals from Jan 1, 2025: before the first renewal requiring CE, then once every six years

rules.notes: 10 hours each license cycle, completed during the 12 months before the expiration date on the license. Only Certified Pharmacy Technicians need CE; Registered Pharmacy Technicians have no CE requirement.
